setting: office-based physician visits (EXCLUDES hospital outpatient and ED)
estimand: pelvic-floor-related ambulatory office visits (UI/POP/pelvic-floor ICD-10 in DIAG1-3); all-provider, condition-defined
source: NAMCS 2019 Public Use File (NCHS/CDC); reproduced by R/calibration-namcs_demand.R::namcs_urps_visit_anchor()
notes: Structural lower bound for ALL-SETTING ambulatory: NAMCS is office-based only (omits HOPD/ED). Provider-specificity: the current model quantity (new_consultation+return_visit) is all-provider condition demand, so the setting bound applies; if ever redefined as FPMRS-specialist visits, NAMCS could be BROADER and the bias direction indeterminate. Do NOT average/blend with MEPS 2023 (9,063,442; different OB-visit frame incl. R15 fecal). No extrapolation used.
